messages.subject: Plot legend without box and title
parts:
Dear Nick,

I have my final figures for a BioGeoBEARS analysis, but I wanted to plot the legend without the box/outline and the title "LEGEND" to make it easier to update it directly in my figure.
I am using 
colors_legend(names(pie_df_lump)[1:(length(pie_df_lump)-1)], colors_list_for_states, legend_ncol=3, legend_cex=1)

Is there a way to eliminate title and outline in the colors_legend function? I couldn't find this info anywhere I looked.

Thanks!
Tauana

messages.author: 115d05260b0c341a
messages.subject: Re: [BioGeoBEARS] Plot legend without box and title
parts:
hi -- I'm under some deadlines, but type colors_legend into R, get the source code, copy into a new function, colors_legend2, and edit the inputs in the legend() command therein, see ?legend, colors_legend is just a quick wrapper for the base R legend().

Cheers!
Nick
